summary: A memo from SRI-ARC supporting Bob Braden's point in RFC 430 about site-dependent FTP parameters. To fetch part of a structured NLS file without changing FTP, the NIC planned to append a field such as ;x program to the pathname used in STOR and RETR. That field would name a program for the server to run.

plainLanguage.summary: This memo proposes a way to attach extra instructions to an FTP pathname. The SRI-ARC server could use them to retrieve a selected view of an NLS file.

subtitle: A pathname convention for passing host-specific information to an FTP server.

tldr.problem: Retrieving a sequential view of an NLS tree-structured file requires information beyond an ordinary filename.
tldr.mechanism: The memo proposes appending a field to the pathname to identify a server program and optional parameters.
tldr.outcome: The proposal describes how SRI-ARC planned to pass conversion, statement-address, and view information without modifying FTP.

today: The unit metadata lists RFC 480's status as Unknown. This memo describes a host-specific FTP pathname proposal.

sections.title: Passing Extra FTP Parameters
sections.content: James White's memo responds to a point about site-dependent FTP parameters in RFC 430. The NIC needed to pass a filename, a statement address, view specifications, and a conversion algorithm to SRI-ARC's FTP server when retrieving an NLS view in sequential form.
sections.plainLanguage: The SRI-ARC server needed more than a filename to retrieve a selected view of an NLS file. The memo proposes passing that information through the pathname.

sections.title: The Pathname Field
sections.content: The proposed field is appended to a standard TENEX filename and has the form ;x program [/ parameters]. The program name tells the server's FTP process what program to dispatch; the file pointer is passed as an argument, along with optional parameters.
sections.plainLanguage: The pathname can name a program for the server to run. Optional parameters can provide more details to that program.

sections.title: Parameters for NLS
sections.content:
For NLS files, the memo says the program name will be NLS. The optional parameters can specify a conversion algorithm with T:, a statement address with S:, and view specifications with V:; any parameters used are separated by commas.

The memo describes a planned convention, not a change to the FTP protocol itself.
sections.plainLanguage: For NLS, optional fields identify a conversion method, statement address, or view settings. The memo presents this as a plan for SRI-ARC's server.

references.text: Braden, R., "Comments on File Transfer Protocol", RFC 430, February 1973.
